# Curated set of well-established recessive-disease genes for reproductive
# carrier screening (ACMG-style + a few high-value additions). The carrier
# screen (mcp/carrier_screen.py) intersects a person's PATHOGENIC / LIKELY-
# this gene list and classifies by zygosity:
#   homozygous / 2+ P-LP hits in one gene -> possible BIALLELIC -> clinical review
# Restricting to a curated recessive panel is deliberate: it keeps the screen
# clinically meaningful and avoids calling every "pathogenic"-labelled dominant/
# inheritance: AR = autosomal recessive; XLR = X-linked recessive (carrier
# interpretation differs by sex — flagged in the note).
# Sources: ACMG carrier-screening recommendations (Gregg et al. 2021 Genet Med);
# OMIM; GeneReviews. EDUCATIONAL ONLY — confirm any hit with clinical testing +
